verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships built-in AI Agents with configurable workflows, custom agent skills, web scraping/search, and dynamic model selection, all accessible within the product itself, and community reviews confirm the agent/RAG feature set works in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of agent task delegation (most community feedback focuses on chat/RAG rather than agent workflows) and clearer detail on agent autonomy/capabilities beyond docs listing.
